The scheduler never claims a band and never merges a worktree; it emits the notice and moves on. *** THE ROW EXISTS NOW ONLY AS A NO-RE-RUN GUARD: the cell was launched by hand on 2026-08-13 and its own chain (run_deploy_jrules_d0p25.sh) owns it. done_if_exists therefore lists FOUR files, not just the completion marker: DONE_ (cell complete), FAILED_ (the <90% VOID path - a VOIDed cell must be READ by a human, never silently re-run on the same band), CHAIN_STARTED (written at chain launch, so the scheduler cannot dispatch a SECOND chain onto a free box while the first is still playing), and READOUT.md. Re-running any of those states would spend band seeds twice or add unplanned workers mid-cell.
